name: What is the typical remodeling process with Simply Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical remodeling process with Simply Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our remodeling process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and needs. Next, we move to design and planning, where we develop detailed plans, select materials, and provide a comprehensive estimate. After contract signing and permit acquisition, construction commences, managed with regular communication. The project concludes with a final walkthrough and your complete satisfaction. We aim for a smooth, transparent, and efficient remodeling experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design and planning, detailed estimates, permit acquisition, construction with ongoing communication, and a final walkthrough upon completion.
